messages.text:
At 12–20¢ the Thor P2 at $369 is the cheap way in: 10 TH/s drawing at the wall, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes, forever, while stacking sats meanwhile.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

For a first miner, the Thor P2 at $369 is the right call — small, quiet enough for a desk, and you learn pools, wallets and firmware on real hardware. Ships October 3.

The Magic M. 40T is four times the hashrate for $799 but ships November 14. Budget or sooner?

Nice — then you've got the shot already running.

What are you after next: the Magic M. 40T alongside it for four times the hashrate, or help getting the P2 pointed at a pool when it lands?
Try to learn about mining with it

Good reason to own one. The P2 runs Harlo OS — it ships in solo mode, and you can switch it to a pool any time by entering a stratum URL, worker name and password in settings, paying out to your own wallet, no exchange.

Firmware and docs live at https://harlolabs.com/.

Want the solo-versus-pool tradeoff in plain terms?

Then it's already set the way you want it — solo out of the box, nothing to configure.

Solo is all-or-nothing: every ten minutes your P2 is drawing for a full 3.125 BTC block, and hashrate is just how many tickets you hold. That's why solo people stack units.

Want me to price a Magic M. 40T next to it?
Before you go, one thing: what made you go with the Thor P2 over the Magic M. 40T?
Makes sense — thanks, and enjoy the P2 when it lands.
Any word from JD on the fan ?
